# Backup Verification Guide

Verify backup integrity and restore procedures.

## Verification Steps
1. Check backup schedule is running
2. Verify backup size is reasonable
3. Test restore to staging environment
4. Validate data integrity post-restore
5. Document recovery time

## Best Practices
- Follow 3-2-1 rule (3 copies, 2 media, 1 offsite)
- Encrypt backups at rest
- Test restores monthly
- Monitor backup job status
